summary: Full backend + frontend test of the new Codebase Health Score widget (2026-08-23). 12/12 pytest backend tests pass; Playwright confirms widget renders on /admin/cockpit with all 9 categories, expand/collapse evidence works, run-coverage button + review notes/submit (with disabled-when-empty behavior) present, and no regression to System Health / Mode Board / Live Business Intelligence sections of the cockpit page. Middleware verified: db.health_endpoint_latency has 963+ samples with BSON date ts field.

minor.issue: Response latency ~7-10s consistently (real live GitHub Actions API + AST codebase scan on every call). Well under the 40s frontend client timeout, but flagged per feature spec — consider a 30-60s in-memory cache if this widget is polled aggressively.

issues: Code Quality shows 9/100 (LIVE) with a red bar — likely correct given 172 bloated files of 679 (evidence json visible), but main agent may want to sanity-check whether the penalty formula overweights bloated_files (1.5x) vs complexity_hits (0.8x) — the score is technically real but visually alarming; not a bug, just calling it out.

action_items: Optional: add short in-memory cache (30-60s) for GET /admin/health-score to reduce per-request GitHub API + AST-scan cost if the widget is polled frequently.

Optional: revisit Code Quality penalty coefficients — a fresh score of 9/100 is technically valid but may feel like a false-alarm to the founder viewing the cockpit; the raw evidence json is visible right below it so it's not misleading, just startling.
critical_code_review_comments: services/health_score.py is 458 lines — under 700-line threshold, single-responsibility, clean. No _id leakage anywhere in payload (services return plain dicts).
routers/admin_health_score.py correctly gates all 4 routes with require_admin_dep; 401/403 verified from unauth calls.
Middleware _health_latency_sampler_mw writes ts as datetime object (BSON date), NOT a string — verified in Mongo query. TTL index on ts (14d) confirmed to exist in main.py startup.
trigger_coverage_run uses asyncio.create_task fire-and-forget correctly; returns {status: 'started'} immediately without holding the request open.
test_credentials: Admin login test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026! worked on preview URL; is_admin=true confirmed in login response.
seed_data_creation: Inserted one TEST_bot architecture review row via POST /admin/health-score/architecture-review (rubric coupling/spof/clarity). Safe to leave — clearly TEST_ prefixed reviewer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is working end-to-end on preview. If retesting, note that the Performance category may now show status='scored' (not 'unscored') because health_endpoint_latency has crossed 200-sample threshold during earlier testing — that's still correct per spec, the spec said 'unscored on fresh install *until* 200+ samples'. Also Security / Bug Density / Reliability MUST stay unscored — that's expected, don't flag.
